title: What if the volcano under Naples erupted? 🌋
subject: volcano
description:
Would you live on top of it? 👇

Campi Flegrei, the supervolcano under Naples, once covered Europe and parts of Russia in ash. The ground has risen 4.6 feet since 2005, and in July 2026 it had its strongest recorded quake. Here's what a full-size eruption would mean, and what scientists actually expect.

Sources: NPR, "Italy's Campi Flegrei supervolcano is stirring" (Nov 2025, quoting INGV volcanologists Giovanni Macedonio and Warner Marzocchi); The Brighter Side of News, INGV bulletin summary (Sep 2026); Wanted in Rome (Aug 2026); The Watchers (May 2026)

scenes.text: At full power, this volcano would cover Europe in ash.
Campi Flegrei sits under Naples. 39,000 years ago, it spewed 72 cubic miles of molten rock.
Ash reached Russia, and global temperatures plunged.
Over half a million people live in its red zone, where the ground has risen 4.6 feet since 2005.
On July 31, 2026, its strongest recorded quake brought down 2 empty buildings in Pozzuoli.
Italy's volcano institute sees no imminent eruption, and expects the next one to be far smaller.
